content: Flutter's Timer.periodic is not precise for beat scheduling; reported drift ranges 100-1000ms for 20ms intervals. For metronome, must use platform audio scheduling (AVAudioEngine on iOS, AudioTrack on Android) rather than Timer alone. Ticker (frame-based) and isolates can improve precision but still inferior to native audio engine scheduling. flutter_gapless_loop and flutter_soloud both use native audio APIs (playClocked/scheduled) for sample-accurate timing unsuitable for Timer.
